title: Sony WH-1000XM5 Review: The Best Noise-Canceling Headphones of 2025
subtitle: A comprehensive review of Sony's flagship ANC headphones
author: Technova Team
content:
In the competitive world of premium noise-canceling headphones, the Sony WH-1000XM5 has established itself as the gold standard. Released in 2022 and still dominating the market in 2025, these headphones represent the pinnacle of Sony's audio engineering expertise.

Design and Comfort

The WH-1000XM5 features Sony's new 'noiseless design' philosophy with a sleek, minimalist aesthetic. The stepless slider mechanism and soft-fit leather earpads provide exceptional comfort for extended listening sessions. At just 250 grams, they're lighter than many competitors while maintaining premium build quality.

The WH-1000XM5 features a sleek, minimalist design available in black and silver.

Sound Quality

Equipped with newly developed 30mm drivers and supporting LDAC codec, the WH-1000XM5 delivers exceptional audio fidelity. The soundstage is wide and immersive, with punchy bass that doesn't overwhelm the mids and highs. DSEE Extreme upscaling technology restores detail to compressed audio files, making even streaming services sound remarkable.

Active Noise Cancellation

Sony's V1 processor combined with eight microphones creates industry-leading noise cancellation. Whether you're on a plane, train, or in a busy office, the WH-1000XM5 effectively eliminates ambient noise. The Auto NC Optimizer automatically adjusts cancellation based on your environment and wearing conditions.

Battery Life and Features

With up to 30 hours of battery life with ANC enabled, these headphones easily last through multiple long-haul flights. Quick charging provides 3 hours of playback from just 3 minutes of charging. Additional features include:

  • Speak-to-Chat technology that pauses music when you start talking
  • Adaptive Sound Control that adjusts settings based on your activity
  • 360 Reality Audio support for immersive spatial sound
  • Multipoint connection for seamless device switching

Verdict

The Sony WH-1000XM5 remains the best all-around noise-canceling headphones you can buy in 2025. For more audio recommendations, check out our Best Wireless Earbuds 2025 comparison. While competitors like the Bose QuietComfort Ultra and AirPods Max offer strong alternatives, the XM5's combination of sound quality, comfort, battery life, and features makes it our top recommendation for most users.

Rating: 9.5/10
